summary: A council member weighs another unpaid term against paid legal work for the same city.
realLife: Calvin Coolidge passed up another unpaid Northampton council term to become city solicitor. He recalled that the salary mattered and the chance to become a better lawyer mattered more.
inGame: needs: a paid city job offer and an unpaid council term with overlapping dates.

turns.what: The member declines the city job and stands for the unpaid term.
turns.pulledBy: Outside earnings cover the member's household and a council matter is unfinished.
turns.writesBack: The member files again and leaves the job open.

turns.what: The member finishes the unpaid term before starting paid city work.
turns.pulledBy: The city can hold the position open until the term ends.
turns.writesBack: The two roles appear consecutively in the work record.
